nvitk.gui.viz.qc_loader.resolve_qvtpy_tree(resource_root: pathlib.Path) → pathlib.Path¶

Return the directory that contains qvtpy/ stage folders.

Accepts a subject root, a qvtpy/ folder, or an XNAT unpack that still has …/resources/qvtpy/files/stage* nesting.
